scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate colorblind-safe palette and thoughtful multi-layer encoding (swarm + percentile lines + marginal box plot) show real design intent, but the percentile labels collide with the subtitle text and the top-earner callout for 'Sam Q.' is clipped at the right edge — concrete layout bugs that cap the score.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate for skewed income data, dot size is fixed (no area-encoding violation), box plot uses correct Tukey fences with data-driven percentiles, and no zero-baseline rule applies to this dot/swarm chart — only flaw is the hardcoded x-domain [14000,550000] instead of d3.extent.
scores.stress_test_note: Fully static layout (force pre-computed, no transitions) with pointer-unified tooltip events only; none of the five interaction traps (update storm, infinite loop, stale scale, mid-flight snap, touch fight) are applicable or present.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 4-category colorblind-safe palette, clean swarm with well-separated colors, and a marginal box plot that shares the axis without adding cognitive load — the 5 leader-line callouts at the high-income tail are slightly busy but remain legible.

proposer: Removed unused `rNorm` variable and eliminated redundant `sorted`/quantile recomputation by reusing `percentileVals` already computed for the percentile lines. -2 lines, 254 total.
